title: One of the best nights of my life- seeing Jeff in person was such a d...
transcript: Join me for a screening of the latest survivor 50 episode with the man himself, Jeff Probst and the survivor 50 Castaways. Tonight was truly a Survivor super fans dream come true. This was hosted at the Paley Museum in New York City, and the night kicked off with a reception with the Survivor 50 Castaways. We got to chat with them, take some photos, they even signed some memorabilia. And the Paley Museum currently has a Survivor 50 exhibit celebrating all 50 seasons of Survivor. So we also got to explore the exhibit and see everything that they had on offer. And it was time to head in for the screening itself. We got to watch tomorrow night's episode a day early, which was really cool. And obviously no spoilers here, but I will say it's another really fun episode. This season keeps delivering. There was one moment with Jeff where my jaw was literally on the ground. I could not believe what I was watching. Y'all are not ready. And then it was time for the talk back, which lasted around 45 minutes. We got to hear Jeff reflect on how the show has evolved over 50 seasons and his anxiety around leaving major game decisions literally in the hands of the fans. And we also got to hear from some players who included Kyle from Season 48, Rizzo from Season 49, and Survivor legend Cirie Fields. And it was cool to hear from them what it meant to be asked back for a major season like 50 and of course got to hear Kyle reflect on his heartbreaking medivac in episode 1. The Paley Center is always doing really cool events like these for movies and TV Shows, so I highly recommend checking out their calendar of future events. There's probably something there that interests you, but as a Survivor super fan, all I can say is wow, what a night!
classificationReason: Content about a Survivor TV show screening event at Paley Museum, not a Broadway show
